works.question: old-testament-canon
works.author: Athanasius of Alexandria
works.why: The best-known early list: the Hebrew books plus Baruch, with Wisdom, Sirach, Esther, Judith and Tobit "not canonized but appointed to be read" by new believers. Survives in Greek fragments and in Coptic.
works.source_hint: Greek fragments, Migne PG 26.1176–1180; Coptic in Lefort (1955, check copyright) or older Schmidt edition

works.question: infant-baptism
works.author: Apostolic Tradition (attributed to Hippolytus)
works.why: Tells the church to baptize the little ones first, with parents or relatives speaking for those who cannot answer. The section survives in Coptic, Arabic and Ethiopic versions, not in the Latin.
works.source_hint: Horner, The Statutes of the Apostles (1904), Sahidic, Arabic and Ethiopic texts
